newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $69 mln trade surplus in 1st wk June.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $69 mln trade surplus in 1st wk June.

text.p: Brazil posted a $69 million trade surplus in the first week of June, with exports totalling $1.149 billion and imports reaching $1.08 billion, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
A ministry spokesman said the average daily exports in June's first five working days were $229.9 million, while average imports reached $215.9 million.
Brazil posted a $271 million trade deficit in May, its lowest shortfall in 12 months thanks to seasonal hikes in agricultural exports.
